name: @wordpress/agent-skill-evals
description: Promptfoo evals that verify agent skills in this repository are discovered, followed, and produce output that meets our rules.
author: The WordPress Contributors

scripts.validate: for c in specs/*/*.test.yaml; do promptfoo validate config --config "$c" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:grader: for t in specs/*/test-grader.mjs; do [ -e "$t" ] || continue; node --test "$t" || exit 1; done
